parameters.text:
=You are a senior content researcher. Find REAL SPECIFIC VERIFIED facts.

BLOG TOPIC: {{$json.topic}}
PRIMARY KEYWORD: {{$json.primary_keyword}}
SECONDARY KEYWORDS: {{$json.secondary_keywords.join(', ')}}
COMPANY: {{$json.company}}
DESCRIPTION: {{$json.description}}

Tasks:
1. Find 12-15 specific facts with numbers, percentages, studies about this topic
2. Identify target audience
3. Identify niche
4. Suggest best writing tone
5. List 3-5 common misconceptions
6. List 3-5 practical use cases
7. Suggest a POWER NUMBER for H1 title. Count the ACTUAL distinct points in your key_facts above. Pick any number between 4 and 10 that best matches the actual number of distinct points you found. Do NOT default to 7 or 9 every time — vary it based on real content. If you found 5 distinct points pick 5. If 6 pick 6. If 8 pick 8. If 10 pick 10. Every blog topic is different so the number must reflect the actual content depth.

Respond ONLY in JSON (no markdown):
{
  "niche": "...",
  "target_audience": "...",
  "tone": "...",
  "search_intent": "...",
  "power_number": 7,
  "key_facts": ["fact1", ...],
  "misconceptions": ["...", ...],
  "use_cases": ["...", ...]
}

const d = $input.first().json;
const structureData = $items('Parse Outline + Build Structure')[0]?.json || {};
const banned = 'delve tapestry multifaceted leverage utilize furthermore moreover robust seamlessly comprehensive em-dashes paramount constituents endeavour facilitate optimal subsequently pertaining detrimental hence thus wherein thereof aforementioned it is imperative one must note it is worth mentioning';
const humanizerPrompt = [
  'You are a human editor. Make this AI blog sound genuinely human.',
  '',
  'BLOG TOPIC: ' + structureData.topic,
  'NICHE: ' + structureData.niche,
  'AUDIENCE: ' + structureData.target_audience,
  'TONE: ' + structureData.tone,
  'PRIMARY KEYWORD: ' + structureData.primary_keyword,
  'SECONDARY KEYWORDS: ' + (structureData.secondary_keywords||[]).join(', '),
  '',
  'FAQ STATUS: ' + (d.faq_was_missing ? 'FAQ IS MISSING. Write 7-8 new complete FAQ questions and answers. Replace all placeholder text with real content about the topic.' : 'FAQ exists. Rewrite all answers in human tone.'),
  '',
  'NEVER TOUCH:',
  '- Any h1 h2 h3 tag and its text content',
  '- Any id or class attribute',
  '- Any href URL',
  '- Any style block',
  '- Any img tag attributes (src alt title loading)',
  '- Any topic-tag span text',
  '- blog-meta content',
  '- Table of contents links',
  '- Any anchor tags inside headings',
  '',
  'REWRITE ONLY: text inside p tags, li tags, details FAQ blocks, expert tip blocks.',
  '',
  'SECONDARY KEYWORDS RULE: Weave ' + (structureData.secondary_keywords||[]).join(', ') + ' naturally in every paragraph throughout.',
  '',
  'HOW TO WRITE:',
  '- Write like explaining to a friend over chai. Simple. Direct. Easy.',
  '- Use simple everyday English. If a 15 year old cannot understand it rewrite it.',
  '- Short sentences mostly. Max 15-18 words per sentence preferred.',
  '- Mix in 1-2 longer sentences per paragraph for flow.',
  '- Always use contractions: dont, isnt, youll, its, thats, cant, wont',
  '- Vary sentence starters constantly',
  '- Use you and your throughout',
  '- No fancy vocabulary. Replace complex words with simple ones.',
  '- No academic tone. No medical journal style. No corporate speak.',
  '- Sound like a knowledgeable friend not a textbook.',
  '- FAQ answers: explain like answering a real person on WhatsApp. 4-6 lines minimum.',
  '- End major sections with Bottom line: or Worth remembering:',
  '',
  'BANNED: ' + banned,
  '',
  'MAX SENTENCE LENGTH: 20 words. Split anything longer.',
  '',
  'INPUT HTML:',
  d.html_draft,
  '',
  'Return ONLY complete raw HTML. No code blocks. Start with first HTML tag. End with last closing tag.'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...d, humanizer_prompt: humanizerPrompt } }];

const d = $input.first().json;
const batchData = $items('Select Pending Batch')[0]?.json || {};
const structureData = d.structureData || {};
const company = batchData.company || '';
const topic = batchData.topic || batchData.primary_keyword || '';
const primaryKeyword = batchData.primary_keyword || '';
const metaTitle = d.metaTitle || d.seo?.meta_title || primaryKeyword;
const blogConclusion = structureData.blog_conclusion || d.blog_conclusion || '';
const h2sText = structureData.h2s ? structureData.h2s.join(' | ') : '';
const sections = structureData.sections || [];
const logoUrl = batchData.logo_url || '';

// Pick product image URL based on keyword
const combined = (topic + ' ' + primaryKeyword).toLowerCase();
let productImageUrl = '';
if (combined.includes('mustard')) productImageUrl = batchData.mustard_oil_url;
else if (combined.includes('groundnut') || combined.includes('peanut')) productImageUrl = batchData.groundnut_oil_url;
else if (combined.includes('a2') || combined.includes('bilona')) productImageUrl = batchData.a2_bilona_cow_ghee_url;
else if (combined.includes('ghee')) productImageUrl = batchData.desi_cow_ghee_url;
else if (combined.includes('walnut')) productImageUrl = batchData.walnuts_url;
else if (combined.includes('almond')) productImageUrl = batchData.almonds_url;
else if (combined.includes('jaggery')) productImageUrl = batchData.jaggery_powder_url;
else productImageUrl = batchData.desi_cow_ghee_url;
productImageUrl = productImageUrl || batchData.desi_cow_ghee_url || '';

// Common header for all prompts
const commonHeader = [
  'You are a world-class food photographer and creative art director working for a premium traditional Indian food brand.',
  '',
  'BRAND: ' + company,
  'Brand Logo: ' + logoUrl,
  'Product Photo: ' + productImageUrl,
  'BRAND DESCRIPTION: Jaipur-based brand selling traditionally prepared, chemical-free, pure Indian food products. Cold pressed oils, A2 bilona ghee, organic jaggery, premium dry fruits. Everything made using traditional methods. No artificial preservatives.',
  'BLOG TOPIC: ' + topic,
  'PRIMARY KEYWORD: ' + primaryKeyword,
  'META TITLE: ' + metaTitle,
].join('\n');

// FEATURED IMAGE PROMPT
const featuredPrompt = [
  commonHeader,
  'BLOG CONCLUSION: ' + blogConclusion,
  '',
  'Your job is to DO ONE perfect image generation for the featured blog image. We need to explain this topic and Conclusion on basis of our featured image.',
  'And on the image we need this text to be visually appealing for the user so that he will try to read the entire blog text: ' + metaTitle,
  'and use our brand logo and Product photo in the blog Featured image.',
  '',
  'RULES:',
  '- Only natural raw ingredients, surfaces, props and lighting',
  '- Must feel premium, traditional, authentic Indian brand',
  '- Warm earthy natural tones',
  '- DSLR food photography quality',
  '- 16:9 landscape format',
  '- Be specific about: shot angle, lighting direction, surface texture, props, depth of field, mood',
  '- 20 words maximum for scene description',
].join('\n');

// SECTION IMAGE PROMPTS — one per H2
const sectionPrompts = sections.map((s, i) => {
  const h2 = s.h2 || '';
  const para = (s.talking_points || []).slice(0, 2).join(' ');
  return [
    commonHeader,
    'H2 HEADING: ' + h2,
    'SECTION PARA: ' + para,
    '',
    'Your job is to DO ONE perfect image generation for this blog section image. We need to explain this H2 and PARA on basis of our section image.',
    'IMAGE MUST EXPLAIN THE CONCLUSION OF THE H2 HEADING AND PARA WITH MINIMAL OR NO WORDS POSSIBLE.',
    'and use our brand logo and Product photo ARE GIVEN WITH THIS MESSAGE.',
    '',
    'RULES:',
    '- Only natural raw ingredients, surfaces, props and lighting',
    '- Must feel premium, traditional, authentic Indian brand',
    '- Warm earthy natural tones',
    '- DSLR food photography quality',
    '- 16:9 landscape format',
    '- Be specific about: shot angle, lighting direction, surface texture, props, depth of field, mood',
  ].join('\n');
});

// Build full combined prompt for Generate Image Prompt AI node
const fullCombinedPrompt = [
  commonHeader,
  'BLOG CONCLUSION: ' + blogConclusion,
  'SECTION H2s: ' + h2sText,
  '',
  'Your job is to DO ONE perfect image generation for the featured blog image. We need to explain this topic and Conclusion on basis of our featured image.',
  'And on the image we need this text to be visually appealing for the user so that he will try to read the entire blog text: ' + metaTitle,
  'and use our brand logo and Product logo in the blog Featured image.',
  '',
  'For the section images we need to explain the h2 headings and PARA on basis of our section image. Image must explain the conclusion of the H2 heading and paragraph with minimal or no words possible and use our brand logo and Product logo ARE GIVEN WITH THIS MESSAGE',
  '',
  'For FEATURED image:',
  '- Only natural raw ingredients, surfaces, props and lighting',
  '- Must feel premium, traditional, authentic Indian brand',
  '- Warm earthy natural tones',
  '- DSLR food photography quality',
  '- 16:9 landscape format',
  '- Be specific about: shot angle, lighting direction, surface texture, props, depth of field, mood',
  '- 20 words maximum',
  '',
  'For EACH SECTION image (one per H2):',
  '- Only natural raw ingredients, surfaces, props and lighting',
  '- Must feel premium, traditional, authentic Indian brand',
  '- Warm earthy natural tones',
  '- DSLR food photography quality',
  '- 16:9 landscape format',
  '- Be specific about: shot angle, lighting direction, surface texture, props, depth of field, mood',
  '',
  'Also provide title and alt text for each image.',
  '- title: 40-60 characters, descriptive, include 1-2 keywords, suitable as image filename title',
  '- alt_text: 10-15 words describing what the image shows',
  'Also provide layout for featured image.',
  '',
  'EXAMPLE featured prompt:',
  'Rustic hand-carved wooden table with visible grain and warm brown tones. Raw shelled groundnuts and a traditional brass oil pot arranged on LEFT side only. RIGHT side deliberately clean and empty for product placement. Soft golden natural light from left casting gentle shadows. Shallow depth of field. Premium wholesome traditional Indian kitchen vibes.',
  '',
  'Respond ONLY in JSON:',
  '{',
  '  "featured": {',
  '    "image_prompt": "your featured background scene prompt",',
  '    "title": "40-60 char image title with 1-2 keywords",',
  '    "alt_text": "10-15 word alt text describing the scene",',
  '    "layout": {',
  '      "product_side": "right or left or center",',
  '      "product_top": "5% to 15%",',
  '      "product_height": "65% to 80%",',
  '      "text_side": "left or right",',
  '      "text_bottom": "40px to 60px",',
  '      "text_max_width": "480px to 580px",',
  '      "logo_corner": "top-left or top-right"',
  '    }',
  '  },',
  '  "sections": [',
  '    {',
  '      "h2": "exact H2 heading",',
  '      "image_prompt": "scene prompt for this section",',
  '      "title": "40-60 char image title with 1-2 keywords",',
  '      "alt_text": "10-15 word alt text for this section image"',
  '    }',
  '  ]',
  '}'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: {
  ...d,
  productImageUrl,
  logoUrl,
  // Individual resolved prompts for Google Doc
  resolvedFeaturedPrompt: featuredPrompt,
  resolvedSection0Prompt: sectionPrompts[0] || '',
  resolvedSection1Prompt: sectionPrompts[1] || '',
  resolvedSection2Prompt: sectionPrompts[2] || '',
  resolvedSection3Prompt: sectionPrompts[3] || '',
  // Full combined prompt for Generate Image Prompt AI node
  fullCombinedPrompt: fullCombinedPrompt
}}];
